entities.summary: Stef Kamil Carlens (b. 1970-09-27, Schoten) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Schoten and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
